BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing.

2. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.

3. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

4. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

6. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

9. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

10. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.

11. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

12. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Site Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
